entries.title: refactor(mobile): compile semantic themes for Uniwind
entries.intent: Mobile themes compile to semantic adaptive tokens, so a registered theme drives colour everywhere instead of dark:/light: utilities guessing at it. Ships the generator (scripts/generate-uniwind-themes.mts), the mobileTheme runtime and variables modules, useUniwindTheme, and the no-mobile-uniwind-theme-escape-hatches lint rule; retires apps/mobile/src/lib/useThemeColor.ts.
entries.reason: We are adopting Uniwind rather than keeping our useThemeColor approach: the token system is the better structure and we should express the RAS Code palette through it. Deferred only because it wants its own change, generating our palette as adaptive tokens across 111 files.
